models.label: java Intended Model
models.description: gctoolkit-api is the foundation. The parser, the messaging backplane, the integration harness and the sample all build on it and not on each other.

groups.label: gctoolkit-api
groups.description: Public model API: GC event types, JVM abstractions, timestamps and the aggregation SPI. The foundation the other modules build on.

groups.label: gctoolkit-parser
groups.description: Parses the supported GC log formats into the API's event model.

groups.label: gctoolkit-vertx
groups.description: Messaging backplane connecting GC log parsers to JVM event consumers.

groups.label: gctoolkit-integration
groups.description: Integration-test harness that exercises the toolkit end to end, through the public API.

groups.label: gctoolkit-sample
groups.description: Sample application demonstrating how to consume the toolkit.
